# BREAKER — The First Layer

BREAKER is a browser-based investigative RPG about Soroban smart contracts on the Stellar testnet. Each case is a real contract with a real flaw; the player investigates it through the in-game Breaker OS or the browser console.

- Season 01: The First Layer
- Languages: pt-BR, en, es
- Stack: React, Vite, Stellar/Soroban

## Pages

- [Home](/) — the season hub and case list.
- [Help](/help) — how to play.
- [Login](/login) — wallet or passkey entry.
